meta.title: RFQ bid: Quote only one of two products
gaps: Conditionally accept either the refusal message "Please quote prices for all the products." / "You have to place bid on atleast one product" or a successful partial bid while recording which behavior occurred.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Conditionally accept either the refusal message "Please quote prices for all the products." / "You have to place bid on atleast one product" or a successful partial bid while recording which behavior occurred.

steps.note: Open the eRFX creation flow for the RFQ test event.
Configure the event as an RFQ rather than the default auction.
Move to the RFQ stage before configuring its template and items.
Create the two products required by the scenario.
Complete the buyer-side pricing sheet so the RFQ can be published.
Invite the QA vendor used for the vendor-portal submission.
Verify that the RFQ reached a published project page.
Use the separate vendor session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open this event from the vendor's event list at its RFQ pricing sheet.
Enter a quote for product 1 only and leave product 2 unquoted.
Attempt to submit the partial quote.
Capture the refusal or success response produced by the partial submission attempt.
